opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion of the *505appellee to dismiss the appeal herein is granted, and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question. Cincinnati Street Ry. Co. v. Snell, 193 U. S. 30; Bain Peanut Co. v. Pinson, 282 U. S. 499, 501.

Mr. Harold M. Wilkie for appellant. Mr. William H. Spohn for appellee.
